title: Darrick's PixelLink Headgear Pack
description: A resource pack that replaces renamed Carved Pumpkins with PixelLink talents' headgear!
body:
My first ever serious project release!\
This resource pack replaces renamed Carved Pumpkins into custom headgear that matches PixelLink's talents!

## 
## ![Optifine Required](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4454592095a26f097ff9d9b0054be37118585a52.png)
**This resource pack requires Optifine to work!**
[![optifine download](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df47e5c78731e258805959ded83b7b8564f195c7.png)](https://optifine.net/downloads)\
**Alternatively, you can use Fabric with CIT Resewn. I've been told that it works.**

Simply rename any Carved Pumpkins into the names above to get the custom headgear! \
Note: The names are not case-sensitive, so you can rename it to "miuna's ribbon" and still get the same result. \
Note 2: The names however must be precise, no additional or missing letters/spacebar

## 
## ![No Pumpkin Blur](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2050837ada3d57de0c292b608fbbb37031f936e.png)
Additionally, this resource pack also removes pumpkin blur, the annoying black shade covering your vision when you wear a Carved Pumpkin! You can wear these custom headgear to your hearts content!

Theoretically this should work for versions between 1.12-1.21++. Never really tested it so I guess we'll find out.
